IndiGo Flight Lands Safely After Lightning Strike Damages Nose

An IndiGo flight carrying 110 passengers made an emergency landing in Lucknow after being struck by lightning at an altitude of 17,000 feet. The incident occurred during severe weather conditions, resulting in damage to the aircraft's nose. The flight was en route from Patna to Lucknow. All passengers and crew are reported to be safe.
